items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (was Q); DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT for Eagles MNF.
items.why: Q but expected; WRs ruled out.
items.implication: Start Saquon; Eagles WR corps thinned elevates other targets/RZ for RB.
items.opportunity: Saquon carries/targets up; AJ Brown or Goedert beneficiaries from WR outs.

items.text: Sunday summary: Puka GTD/optimism, Breece GTD/pessimism, Saquon expected, Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson IN, Lamar/DeVonta/Wicks OUT. Mike Washington GTD.
items.implication: Update all lineups/DFS on these statuses; projections refreshed.
items.opportunity: Direct for INs; beneficiaries for OUTs like Eagles/Ravens skill.

items.text: Rams optimistic Puka Nacua (calf, Q) will play vs Raiders; feeling better Saturday, 'as long as no setbacks' available.
items.why: Calf improved; sources confident barring setback.
items.implication: Start Puka with confidence if cleared; high-upside WR1 potential.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected if active; Adams already OUT elevates role.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) unlikely to play today vs Dolphins; may workout but not full participant yet, bit early in return.
items.why: Quad strain after missing 3 games; limited practice.
items.implication: Sit Breece; monitor for inactive confirmation.
items.opportunity: Backup RB volume spike if inactive.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; third straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited practice but ruled out.
items.implication: Sit Lamar; Huntley starts, potential boost to Ravens pass-catchers in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Increased volume for Flowers, Andrews, Henry under Huntley.

items.text: All ETR projections updated to reflect latest news (Lamar OUT, Puka opt, Breece pess, etc).
Rico Dowdle and DeShon Elliott both up (active) for Steelers vs Saints.
items.implication: Dowdle viable if role expands; check snaps.
items.opportunity: Potential committee or lead if others limited.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans.
items.implication: Start Skattebo as RB2/flex with volume.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, RZ work as lead.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.implication: Start/upgrade Jacobs in favorable spot; monitor snap share post-layoff.
items.opportunity: Lead back role return; handcuff downgrades.
items.conflict: Berry previously hated post-layoff workload questions.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for MNF vs Dallas; Dontayvion Wicks also OUT.
items.implication: Sit both; look to Eagles alternatives.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining WRs/TEs and Saquon.

items.text: Lamar/Puka/Breece statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate. Sneaky scratches: Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka. Tempted by CMC more slot amid 49ers WR outs despite usual skepticism.
items.why: Injury leverage and role expansion potential.
items.implication: Pivot DFS on news; CMC upside if slot heavy; fade scratched.
items.opportunity: CMC routes/targets up with Evans/Deebo/Adams OUT; Egbuka/Warren/BRob gone means backups rise.
items.conflict: Rarely trusts RB-as-WR but 49ers situation extreme.

items.text: OUTs include Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery.
items.opportunity: 49ers: CMC/Kittle; Rams: Puka elevated further; others backups.

items.text: Sat night: Q Lamar/Puka/Breece/Mayfield/Dowdle/etc; OUT Evans/Deebo/Adams/Rice/Love/Mont/Egbuka/Warren/Charbonnet/BRob; IN Jacobs/Judkins/Addison/etc.
items.implication: Baseline for Sunday monitoring; many changes overnight.
items.opportunity: INs like Judkins/Addison startable; OUTs create voids.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield returns (was Q, glove for thumb); Lamar was close but OUT, should next week.
items.implication: Start Mayfield/Bucs skill; Lamar next week hopeful.
items.opportunity: Bucs offense full speed; Evans still OUT so Godwin/Irving up.

items.text: Broncos CB Pat Surtain II (ankle) unlikely to play today; good chance back next week.
items.implication: Boost to opposing WRs (e.g. vs Broncos).
items.opportunity: WR matchup upgrade if facing DEN.

items.text: Activated/expected: Josh Jacobs, Jordan Mason, Jonah Coleman, Tank Dell, Christian Kirk among others.
items.implication: Monitor roles for Dell/Kirk returns; Jacobs startable.
items.opportunity: Dell/Kirk target shares if full go.

items.text: Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues; by end of year the Broncos RB you wish you had. Activated/IN.
items.implication: Add immediately if available; stash/priority waiver.

items.text: Loves: AJ Brown (usage/matchup), Tucker Kraft (TE buffet vs DET), volume plays. Hates: Rome Odunze (shadow), Josh Downs, Kelce tough D, Jacobs post-layoff. Top-10 includes Gibbs-Bijan-CMC etc; Puka high if plays.
items.implication: Start loves; fade hates; adjust for news (Jacobs now IN, DeVonta was loved pre-OUT).
items.conflict: Jacobs now active contradicts prior hate somewhat.
